subject: Invite sprint: architect clinic — RSVP windows, tracking & reminders
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alice Song <alice.song@acme.dev>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invite sprint: architect clinic — RSVP windows, tracking & reminders

Hi Marissa / Alice,

Thanks again for co-hosting the 60-minute Architect Clinic on June 23. I want to lock the invite sprint cadence and tracking conventions so we can hand off the final send window to Ops tomorrow. High level asks below — please reply with confirmations or edits.

What I propose:
- RSVP windows: open now (seed + broad), priority wave (architects & platform leads) 2 weeks before event, general wave 7 days before.
- Reminders: immediate confirmation after RSVP; 72 hours before for registrants; 24 hours before; 1 hour before (short mobile copy).
- Tracking links: dual-layer approach — canonical redirect with partner domain (acme redirect) + UTM suffixes we control. Naming example: ?utm_source=redwood&utm_campaign=launchpad_06023&utm_segment=architects&utm_wave=1
- Subject variants (quick A/B):
  * "Architect Clinic: LLM serving best practices — June 23 (Seats limited)"
  * "Invite: Architect Clinic — Live Q&A on LLM inference"

Segmentation and seeds: see audience_seed_v2.csv. We should split engineers (lower-touch), architects/platform leads (high-touch + calendar hold). Marissa — can you confirm the subject variants and timings? Alice — can Acme provide the co-brand image (1200x628) and the redirect domain you mentioned?

Attachments: invite_copy_v3.docx (primary copy), audience_seed_v2.csv (seed lists). I'll put the working spreadsheet in Drive and share after we lock copy.

Action items:
1) Marissa: copy + reminder cadence sign-off by EOD tomorrow.
2) Alice: redirect domain + co-brand asset by Tue 5/19.
3) Ops: once signed off, we ship send schedule to deliverability 24h before first wave.

Thanks — want this short so Ops can implement.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Field Marketing (EMEA & US)
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Invite sprint: architect clinic — RSVP windows, tracking & reminders

On Sun, May 17, 2026 at 09:12 Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for co-hosting...

Love this — short notes from me:

1) Subject lines: favor the shorter variant for engineers and full variant for architects. Suggest we test urgency vs value:
   - Engineers A: "Architect Clinic: LLM serving best practices — June 23"
   - Architects A: "Invite: Architect Clinic — Live Q&A on LLM inference (limited seats)"

2) Reminder cadence: agree with 72/24/1 hour. For timezone handling I recommend "wave windows" rather than absolute times — sends at 9am local for each region wave to avoid late-night touches.

3) Tracking: the UTM pattern Markus suggested is good. A couple of ops asks: please append &link_id={{email_link_id}} for click-level tieback to the send (HubSpot link token). Example: ?utm_source=redwood&utm_campaign=launchpad_06023&utm_segment=architects&utm_wave=1&link_id={{email_link_id}}

4) Copy: attached I updated the hero line to focus on "serving economics" and added a 1-line speaker bulleted list. See invite_copy_v3.docx — small track changes.

I can sign off by EOD Monday if we get the co-brand asset from Acme and the redirect domain. Also recommend we add a one-question priority prompt in the RSVP form ("Which area is your top priority: latency, cost, reliability?") so we can route registrants to the right session flow.

— Marissa
Sr. Manager, Demand Gen | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks Alice, Marissa. Final notes for Ops handoff (I uploaded the master sheet as invite_sequence_final.xlsx in Drive):

- Send waves (local send time 9:00 AM local):
   Wave 1 (Priority architects): 2026-06-09 09:00 local (seed + high-touch)
   Wave 2 (General engineers): 2026-06-16 09:00 local (broad list)
   Reminder 1: immediate confirmation triggered by RSVP
   Reminder 2: 72 hours before each attendee's event time (local)
   Reminder 3: 24 hours before
   Reminder 4: 1 hour before (short, CTA: "Join Architect Clinic")

- Link naming: use the UTM pattern + &link_id={{email_link_id}}. Example: https://events.acme.dev/redirect?dest=https%3A%2F%2Fredwood.ai%2Fevents%2Flaunchpad&utm_source=redwood&utm_campaign=launchpad_06023&utm_segment=architects&utm_wave=1&link_id={{email_link_id}}

- RSVP form: Marissa's label options: "Latency", "Cost", "Reliability" — Alice, please add as dropdown choices on the registration page.

Ops: once you confirm the send table and mapping, I'll schedule the first wave. If any deliverability checks are required (co-brand image size, alt text, DKIM alignment with the redirect) call out asap.

Thanks all — quick turn here but we're on track.

— Markus
